objective: Audit a recognizable interactive web application. Treat documented intentionally vulnerable training behaviors as product context rather than automatically calling every designed challenge a regression. Focus on executed user journeys, runtime/API evidence, security boundaries, and clearly scoped behavior or improvement observations.

Audit a small recognizable Docker web application as a low-complexity backup. Exercise the actual UI, repository structure, startup behavior and bounded performance checks. Report uncertainty when richer API behavior is not present.

Audit a recognizable minimal HTTP service as an infrastructure-oriented backup. Exercise real HTTP behavior, repository/security inspection and bounded performance checks. Do not invent browser journeys that the product does not expose.
